# Trillas Consulting Engineers (TCE)
> Full-service engineering firm in Miami Lakes, Florida — structural design, cold-formed steel (CFS) engineering, MEP systems, forensic investigations, and product R+D. Licensed to practice and seal engineering documents in 30 states, D.C., and Puerto Rico (32 jurisdictions). Phone 786-542-5474 · info@trillasengineering.com

## Services
- [Structural Design & Analysis](https://www.trillasengineering.com/structural-design.html): new construction, renovations, expansions, threshold inspections — low- to high-rise
- [Cold-Formed Steel Engineering](https://www.trillasengineering.com/cold-formed-steel.html): engineer-of-record (EOR) or delegated specialty engineer for single-family through mid-rise, multifamily, mixed-use, commercial and prefab; sealed calculations and drawings plus production machine files for Howick, Scottsdale (Vertex/SCS) and FrameCAD roll-forming equipment
- [MEP System Design](https://www.trillasengineering.com/mep-engineering.html): mechanical, electrical, plumbing — coordinated in-house with the structure
- [Forensic Investigations](https://www.trillasengineering.com/forensic-investigations.html): hail, wind, hurricane, water, fire and construction-defect evaluations; cause of damage and scope of repair; facade & building envelope forensic audits; fatigue and component failure analysis; expert testimony
- [Product R+D](https://www.trillasengineering.com/product-rd.html): building-product design, materials, testing and approval support

## Key pages
